candidates.name: label_prototype_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Incrementally updated per-label semantic profiles will retain label coverage, reduce mean injected memory below fewshot_all's 4,330 characters, and exceed its 63.3% mean validation accuracy; the claim fails if profiles lose useful distinctions or miss either target.

candidates.name: countercheck_fewshot
candidates.hypothesis: A second skeptical pass that weighs the strongest supporting and conflicting precedent will raise mean validation accuracy above fewshot_all's 63.3%; the claim fails if the audit does not correct enough first-pass errors.

candidates.name: semantic_case_cards
candidates.hypothesis: LLM-written case cards capped at 80 words will preserve decision-relevant facts, reduce mean injected memory below fewshot_all's 4,330 characters, and exceed its 63.3% mean validation accuracy; this fails if compression removes needed exceptions.
